Re: Urgent- Palisades Park- Vote no on artificial turf
1 message

Rap Commissioners <rap.commissioners@lacity.org>  Tue, Sep 15, 2026 at 3:27 PM
To: Janelle Pauer <  >
Cc: Jimmy Kim <jimmy.kim@lacity.org>, Councilmember Park <councilmember.park@lacity.org>

 Good afternoon,
 Thank you for contacting the Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners Office, your email will be forwarded to the
 Commissioners.

 On Tue, Sep 15, 2026 at 3:01 PM Janelle Pauer <  > wrote:
  Hello,
  I am a local Pacific Palisades resident and the mother of 4 young
  children. I am writing to let you know that I strongly oppose
  replacing natural grass with artificial turf at the Palisades
  Recreation Park Field. I ask you to reject the Palisades Park Advisory
  Board's recommendation to install artificial turf at Thursday's
  meeting.

  Thank you.
  Janelle Pauer
